correctness.rationale: Exact polynomial P_x and strictly negative real derivative give a unique real pole. Vieta yields |Z|^2-R^2=6-15R/4 and the unique crossing x=141/250. Exact-rational and high-precision standalone checks support algebra without replacing the infinite proof.
